prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim. Injury: wrist fracture. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1007; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a sideswipe collision during a lane change on a multi-lane roadway. Insured vehicle contacted the claimant's vehicle on the driver side rear quarter panel. Both drivers reported to be ambulatory at scene. Recorded initial statements from both parties. Claimant reports pain in left wrist and has not yet received medical evaluation. Photos requested.

Entry 2: Spoke with claimant by phone. Claimant confirmed she was struck while traveling in the adjacent lane and believes the other vehicle merged without checking its mirrors. Claimant was taken to urgent care from the scene and was diagnosed with a fracture of the left wrist. Claimant is not represented by an attorney and says she is handling the claim directly. Requested medical records and authorization forms.

Entry 3: Reviewed scene photos and the insured's statement. Insured states he signaled and checked his blind spot but did not see the claimant's vehicle until contact. Damage appears consistent with the described lane change. Police report reviewed; citation not issued to either driver. Preliminary liability assessment leans toward the insured based on the lane change, pending witness follow-up.

Entry 4: Received urgent care records confirming a distal radius fracture of the left wrist. Orthopedic follow-up is scheduled and the claimant reports she may need a cast for several weeks, with possible physical therapy afterward. Claimant has not been asked to sign a release. Explained the general claims process and that she may wish to seek legal advice, which she declined to consider at this time.

Entry 5: Contacted independent witness listed on the police report. Witness confirmed the insured's vehicle moved into the claimant's lane without a clear gap. Medical bills and wage documentation requested from claimant. Claim remains open for injury evaluation. Next follow-up set for review of orthopedic records once received.
